Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the vault toilet located inside the group camping area. This is the only vault toilet in the area. There are other restrooms with flush toilets available around the campground as well as restrooms with showers in them.
Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the entrance to the group camping area. This has the small shelter in the back ground.

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a view of the lake from the camping area! This is located near the turn around at the end of the camping area. There are grills and fire rings that you can use.

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the shelter that is located in the area. The shelter does have electricity but does not have an electricity hook up for a camper. There are picnic tables under the shelter. There is also a water spigot near by for your use.

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the grassy area located behind the shelter. This area has fire rings for you to use as well as lantern holders. There is a small paved parking area within the group camping area.

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the designated swim beach located beside Mays Chapel Group Camping Area. This swim beach is open to other campers as well. There is a life jacket loaner station available for you to borrow life jackets. When you are around or in water, please be sure to wear your life jacket and size it right!

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of a parking lot located behind the group camping area. This parking lot is designed for people who are using the camping area as well as the beach area.

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of some of the picnic tables available in the area. There is no designated areas for tents to set up. Mays Chapel is very open with few trees.
Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of some of the picnic tables in the area. There are no designated spots for tents to set up in this group camping area.
Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a view of the lake from the camping area!

Welcome to Mays Chapel Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the shelter area along with one of the grills located near by. This shelter does have electricity but does not have an electricity hook up for a camper.

Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the shelter that is located within the area. The shelter has grills, picnic tables and electricity. There are also water spigots located near-by.

Welcome to North Bend Park! This is a picture of the Area A boat ramp. This boat ramp is open to campers as well as an over-flow area for boaters coming from the main ramp. There is no designated parking at this ramp, therefore you are allowed to park along the edges of the road. Please use caution when parking and please be sure that your vehicle and trailer are out of the way of the road and allow for other users to utilize the ramp as well.

Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of one of the campsites within Piney Woods Group Camping Area. These campsites are designed for tent campers. Some of these campsites have campsite posts with them while others do not. Not all campsites are gravel; some of them are more dirt. There are also larger grills located throughout the area.

Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the vault toilet that is located right outside the gates. This vault toilet is used for Piney Woods Group Campers as well as any of the public who uses the Area A boat ramp near by.

Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of some of the campsites located in the back part of Piney Woods. In this picture you can see the water spigots located near the shelter as well as some of the campsites with campsite posts in the back ground.

Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the main entrance. Piney Woods is typically gated when not in use. If you have Piney Woods reserved and the gate is closed please call the gate house to get a ranger to come open the gates for you.

Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the beach area that is located behind Piney Woods. This is not a designated swimming area and you would be swimming at your own risk. Please make sure you are wearing a life jacket when you are in or around water! This beach is just a quick walk through the woods and is fairly sandy.
Welcome to Piney Woods Group Camping Area! This is a picture of the shelter located within the camping area. You can also see another spigot that can be used for this area.
